title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. Can you think about how the regularization term might affect the estimation of theta?

title: The Role of Lambda
text: The regularization parameter lambda controls the strength of the penalty on large coefficients. A larger lambda means more penalty. How do you think this affects the flexibility of the model?

title: Is Theta Fixed?
text: Consider the nature of theta in the context of ridge regression. Is it a fixed parameter in the true model, or is it something we estimate?
